'''Happy Landing''' was the main [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] of the [[Tazan starport]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]].

==Description==
Happy Landing was two stories high and was situated just outside the Tazan [[Spaceport/Legends|starport's]] main gate. Inside, the cantina had many small rooms and it also had a balcony that offered panoramic views of [[Tazan City]]. The cantina's clientele consisted primarily of [[Human/Legends|Human]] locals and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] of various [[Species/Legends|species]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Happy Landing was owned and operated by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Fringer/Legends|fringer]] [[Lex Dewiller]]. Sometime after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents traveled to Tazan and visited Happy Landing.
